name: telephonepole
short: Dynamically registers third-party MCP servers for registered A2A agents.
description: Lets a bot owner register/unregister external MCP tools servers at runtime, making their tools available to a registered A2A agent's own tool loop, gated per server and per agent -- the same corridor AgentToolServerRegistry pattern suggestionbox uses for its own in-process server, generalized to any third-party MCP endpoint.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users. It stores bot-owner-registered third-party MCP server names/URLs and a per-server, per-agent access list.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Register a third-party MCP server with [p]telephonepole add <name> <url> and grant a registered A2A agent access via [p]telephonepole agents <name> (all bot owner).
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
